qualification.details: Qualification: 2nd Class Post Graduate degree in Demography / Population Studies / Statistics / Biostatistics / Economics / Mathematics / Sociology / Social work / Psychology / Anthropology / Geography / Public Health from a recognized Institution / University with 1 year post qualification experience. Experience: One year of experience post qualification (i.e. after Post Graduation). Relaxable in deserving cases.

how_to_apply: Download the application form from the CRRID website: www.crrid.res.in.
Fill out the application form duly.

Send documentary proof of claims along with the form in a sealed envelope to The Secretary-cum-Establishment Officer (SEO), CRRID, Madhya Marg, Sector 19-A, Chandigarh 160 019 either by hand, by post, or through email at [email protected].
Make sure it reaches by 20 November 2026.
